# Let's fetch all sent payment requests by paginating to ensure we have all of them
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter requests created on 2023-05-19 (yesterday)
yesterday_requests = [r for r in all_requests if r["created_at"].startswith("2023-05-19")]
print("Yesterday's requests count:", len(yesterday_requests))
for r in yesterday_requests:
    print(r)
